text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $80k with minimal momentum, while Ethereum is showing fractionally more strength at +0.7%, suggesting modest confidence in both majors despite greed conditions. BTC dominance at 59.2% indicates the market is leaning into the largest asset, though altcoins like BNB are struggling while smaller-cap plays like SOL gain, revealing selective rather than broad-based conviction. The Fear & Greed index climbing to 73 with $66B in daily volume reflects optimism, but the lack of decisive upside in either major suggests participants are cautious about extending gains from here.
